title: InventOR: Can Large Language Models Set Reorder Points and Safety Stocks? Industrial Evidence Against ERP and Data-Driven Benchmarks
description: Confidentiality-screened InventOR release prepared as version 1.3.0: analysis code, the approved masked industrial panel, three frozen original generations rescaled to that panel (O1*–O3*), three fresh masked generations (M1–M3), sanitized provenance retaining hash-amendment histories, and credential-free numerical replay. Six-run evidence, the matched 338-pair table and figure sources share one underlying panel, not six independent datasets. Includes APA seventh-edition manuscript sources and an integrity manifest. Original-scale confidential results and proprietary inference are not independently regenerable; capacity-clipped replay does not prove simultaneous MOQ/capacity compliance. No new archive DOI has been assigned in these prepared files.
